source: kenyanstocks.com financial statements API (farmed); FY2025 and FY2024 from the issuer: Limuru Tea Plc audited results announcement for the year ended 31 December 2025 (NSE filing dated 22 April 2026). The filing states figures in KShs thousands; stored here in absolute KES. | FY2022 Profit Before Tax and EPS added from Limuru Tea Plc audited results for the year ended 31 December 2023, NSE filing library, whose comparative column prints Turnover 122,937, Profit before income tax 16,363 and Earnings per share KShs 4.75 for the year ended 31 December 2022. Figures in KShs thousands as filed, stored here in absolute KES. | kenyanstocks.com financial statements API, farmed harvest. Profit Before Tax derived as Net Profit plus Income Tax; Gross Profit as Revenue minus Cost of Sales. Cross checked: Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit and Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit. | CRON 20260929_003746: Income Tax sign normalised to the dataset convention, the charge stored positive and a credit negative, on 2 period(s), so that the rendered Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit. The required sign is fixed by the direction of the move from Profit Before Tax to Net Profit in the stored rows, and the stored magnitude already agreed with that move. | CRON 20260929_003746: FY2022 Net Profit 11,345,000 filled from the stored Profit After Taxation row for FY2022, and FY2022 Profit Before Tax 16,363,000 restored from the Limuru Tea Plc audited results for the year ended 31 December 2023, whose comparative column prints Profit before income tax 16,363 and Earnings per share KShs 4.75 for the year ended 31 December 2022, both in KShs thousands. Those two differ from the stored FY2022 tax line by 73 thousand, which no printed line explains and which is recorded here rather than reconciled away.
source_note: Farmed from the kenyanstocks.com statement API on 2026-09-21. Every cell is computed: line items carried from the source (0 where absent), group subtotals and statement totals computed by identity. No blanks. | EPS FY2021 read from Limuru-Tea-Plc-Results-for-the-Year-Ended-31st-December-2022.pdf H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://africanfinancials.com/document/ke-limt-2026-ir-hy/): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled. UNIT APPLIED: figures converted x1000 from the unit stated in the filing (e.g. Kshs '000). Conversion only where the result reconciles with the annual column.
